notes.content:
[previewyoutube=KKSjUgiEnJM;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello guys!

New Updates to the game:

-Better gameplay
-New speed effects
-New Acceleration animations in the ship
-New ship's material
-Improved and optimized graphics
-Water track updated
-New sounds
